title: Spontaneous Brillouin spectrum of water under a focused sheet beam (frequency response, em_fdfd_ez drive, analytic)
description:
Spontaneous Brillouin scattering of water at 532 nm by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem: an em_fdfd_ez focused_beam (waist 1 um, 1 W/m, toward +y from a line just below the drive rectangle) in library water_532nm on a uniform 12.5 nm tensor mesh (31.9 cells per wavelength in water) is solved first as the background of the frequency_response study; its non-conjugated field product E_z E_z, times the photoelastic p12 = 0.31, drives a plane-strain solid of the same water (formulation mixed P2 / P1: a compressible viscous liquid, G* = j omega eta, K* = K + j omega eta_b) inside the 2.4 x 4 um drive rectangle around the focus (30 nm triangles there, 80 nm elsewhere, fixed walls 1.1 um or more away). brillouin_scattering reports psd(f) = (2 k_B T / Omega)(-Im w^H u) / L per sideband (L = axial_length 10 um) at 21 frequencies over 6.4 - 8.4 GHz, and psd_reference with reference homogeneous: the exact plane-wave sum of the same drive in an unbounded medium.
Analytic: f_B = 2 n v / lambda0 = 7.439 GHz (n 1.335, v = sqrt(K / rho) = 1482.3 m/s) and the intrinsic linewidth Gamma / (2 pi) = q^2 (4/3 eta + eta_b) / (2 pi rho) = 0.656 GHz at q = 4 pi n / lambda0. The drive rectangle cuts the beam to a length L_d = 4 um, 5.6 attenuation lengths 2 v / Gamma: the line is the Lorentzian-in-q phonon line convolved with the sinc^2 of the cut, s(x) = 1 / (1 + x^2) - eps (1 - x^2) / (1 + x^2)^2 (x = detuning / half width, eps = 2 v / (Gamma L_d) = 0.18, exp(-1 / eps) = 4e-3 dropped), whose half-maximum width is fwhm_box = 1.237 x 0.656 GHz = 0.811 GHz. The wide beam (Rayleigh range 7.9 um) keeps the drive a near plane wave: its q is within ~1e-3 of 2 n k0 (pupil pairs ~1e-3 lower, Yee dispersion (k dx)^2 / 24 = 1.6e-3 higher).
Derived values tab: shift_fem (Lorentz-fit centre of psd) against the DHO peak sqrt(f_B^2 - fwhm_law^2 / 2) = 7.425 GHz (5e-3), fwhm_fem (half-maximum width of psd) against fwhm_box (3e-2: the beam taper along the drive, ~0.5 %, the Lorentzian-in-q kernel vs the damped oscillator, ~1 %, and the sampling of the half-maximum crossings), shift_ratio and fwhm_ratio against the homogeneous reference (2e-3, 1.5e-2: the solid's P2 / P1 dispersion). Derived curves tab: psd_over_homogeneous (psd / psd_reference over the band, dotted 1; 4e-2: the drive samples the optical fields bilinearly at the quadrature points where the reference rasters the cell values, (q dx)^2 / 12 = 1.3 % low uniformly, plus the dispersion on the flanks). Curves & tables tab: solid.brillouin (psd, psd_stokes, psd_anti_stokes, psd_reference, psd_db; extras shift, fwhm, gamma from the damped-oscillator fit, reference_shift, scattered_fraction, q_mean, incident_power). Run time about a minute (one optical factorisation, 21 solid factorisations of ~2e5 unknowns).

parameters.name: dx_o
parameters.description: optical cell (31.9 cells per lambda0 / n)

parameters.name: h_drive
parameters.description: triangle size in the drive rectangle (lambda0 / (12 n) = 33 nm)

parameters.name: W_dom
parameters.description: window width (7.8 um: the line holds the beam to 6.5e-7 of its peak)

parameters.name: x_d0
parameters.description: drive rectangle left edge (on an optical cell face)

parameters.name: y_line
parameters.description: beam line height: the centre of window row 83, just below the drive (total-field side)

parameters.name: w0
parameters.description: focal waist (1/e field radius); Rayleigh range pi n w0^2 / lambda0 = 7.9 um

parameters.name: fwhm_law
parameters.description: intrinsic linewidth (FWHM) of one plane-wave phonon [Hz]

parameters.name: eps_d
parameters.description: attenuation length 2 v / Gamma over the drive length

parameters.name: fwhm_box
parameters.description: half-maximum width of the line cut by the drive length [Hz] (description)
